description: Ask the human for free-text refinement through the configured Nofax Refine iOS Shortcut. Use this when free-text edits are needed; use nofax_request_approval for Allow/Deny or nofax_request_choice for predefined options. Returns a durable pending requestId; call nofax_wait_for_response and repeat while pending.

message.description: Context or draft the human should refine with free text.

title.description: Optional refinement prompt title shown to the human; defaults to "Nofax refinement".

name: nofax_request_refinement

instruction.description: Fail-closed next-step instruction for the caller.

mustWait.description: Signals that the caller must keep waiting for a terminal human response.

status.description: The request is unresolved and must not be treated as approval.

title: Request human refinement
